verified_facts.text: Anse Chastanet sits on a private estate of 600 tropical acres on the south-west coast of St. Lucia and borders two soft-sand Caribbean beaches.
verified_facts.excerpt: Positioned on a private estate of 600 lush tropical acres, Anse Chastanet borders two pristine soft-sand Caribbean beaches and offers access to untouched coral reefs just offshore

verified_facts.text: The estate is a gateway to the Pitons, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, and fronts two bays within a designated marine reserve that protects coral reefs.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our estate is a gateway to the iconic Pitons, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, and fronts two bays within a designated marine reserve, protecting vibrant coral reefs.

verified_facts.text: Anse Chastanet was created by architect and owner Nick Troubetzkoy.
verified_facts.excerpt: Created by architect and owner Nick Troubetzkoy, Anse Chastanet transcends traditional hospitality concepts by integrating the surrounding foliage, flowers, and scenic views into the guest experience.

verified_facts.text: Octagonal whitewashed cottages come with wraparound flower-draped balconies and louvered windows to make the most of the views and tradewinds.
verified_facts.excerpt: To make the most of the panoramic views and the refreshing tradewinds octagonal whitewashed cottages come with wraparound flower-draped balconies and louvered windows.

verified_facts.text: In one suite the balcony is built around a full-grown red gommier tree, and some suites have their fourth wall open entirely to the views while remaining private.
verified_facts.excerpt: in one suite, the balcony is built around a full-grown red gommier tree; in another a flamboyant tree drapes its red blossoms around the balcony. Some have their fourth wall open entirely to the vistas, yet are completely private.

verified_facts.text: Room furniture is individually designed and handmade in the region from island woods such as teak, mahogany, green heart, red cedar and wild breadfruit.
verified_facts.excerpt: The furniture has been individually designed and handmade in the region with the exclusive use of island woods such as teak, mahogany, green heart, red cedar, and wild breadfruit.

verified_facts.text: Cushions and bedspreads are made from madras, the island's national cloth.
verified_facts.excerpt: Cushions and bedspreads are made from colorful cotton fabrics called madras, the island’s “national cloth.”

verified_facts.text: Premium rooms sit on the higher hillside level with views of the Pitons and the Caribbean Sea.
verified_facts.excerpt: Anse Chastanet’s Premium rooms offer picture postcard perfect views of St. Lucia’s Pitons – a UNESCO World Heritage site – and the surrounding Caribbean Sea by virtue of their location on the higher hillside level.

verified_facts.text: Beachside deluxe rooms have a tropical garden view and are just a few feet from the beach and the water's edge.
verified_facts.excerpt: All beachside rooms offer a tropical garden view and are just a few feet away from the beach and water’s edge.

verified_facts.text: The Anse Chastanet reef begins just steps from the shoreline.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Anse Chastanet reef begins just steps from the shoreline and descends into a spectacular underwater world of volcanic formations, coral gardens, sponge communities, and over 150 species of tropical fish.

verified_facts.text: Guests may explore the resort's coral nursery with one of its marine biologists.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests may explore our coral nursery with one of our Marine Biologists, participate in guided Reef Revelations snorkeling experiences, attend complimentary Ocean Discovery Talks

verified_facts.text: The resort offers 12 miles of jungle biking, walking and hiking trails in the Anse Mamin valley, with birdwatching.
verified_facts.excerpt: 12 miles of jungle biking, walking, and hiking trails in the Anse Mamin valley with excellent birdwatching options

verified_facts.text: The resort has the Kai Belte Spa.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Kai Belte Spa, Scuba St. Lucia, a watersports center with complimentary snorkeling gear

verified_facts.text: Yoga is held daily in the morning and evening in the beach gazebo.
verified_facts.excerpt: Yoga daily in the morning and evening in our beach gazebo

verified_facts.text: Complimentary non-motorized water sports include snorkel gear, windsurfers, sit-on-top kayaks, Sunfish sailing and paddle boarding.
verified_facts.excerpt: Non-motorized water sports including snorkel gear, windsurfers, sit on top kayaks, Sunfish sailing, paddle

verified_facts.text: The Treehouse Restaurant serves dinner in two open-air treehouses overlooking tropical foliage and the Caribbean Sea, with a menu that changes daily.
verified_facts.excerpt: Dine in our two open air treehouses overlooking lush tropical foliage and the Caribbean Sea.

verified_facts.text: All the resort's kitchens receive organic produce from its farm Emeralds in the Soufriere hills.
verified_facts.excerpt: all of our kitchen receive organic produce from our resort farm Emeralds in the Soufriere hills

verified_facts.text: Guests can sail on the resort yacht Suzi Q on half-day, full-day and sunset cruises.
verified_facts.excerpt: Very popular with Anse Chastanet guests are the half day, full day and sunset cruises offered on the resort yacht ‘Suzi Q’.

verified_facts.text: The Sulphur Springs, the Louis XVI Mineral Baths, the rainforest and the Pitons are all within a short distance of the resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Sulphur Springs, St. Lucia’s famous walk-in volcano, the Louis XVI Mineral Baths, the Tropical Rain Forest and the famous Twin Pitons – all these sites are within a short distance of Anse Chastanet.

verified_facts.text: There are approximately 100 stairs from beach level to mid-hillside level, making the property unsuitable for those with walking difficulties or cardiac problems.
verified_facts.excerpt: Please note that there are approximately 100 stairs leading from beach level to mid-hillside level, thus making the property unsuitable for those with walking difficulties or cardiac problems.

verified_facts.text: Children ages eight and over are welcome year-round.
verified_facts.excerpt: Children ages eight and over are welcome year-round

verified_facts.text: The resort is an hour's drive or a six-minute helicopter ride from Hewanorra International Airport.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located an hour’s drive or a six-minute helicopter ride from St. Lucia’s Hewanorra International Airport (UVF)

verified_facts.text: Kai Belte Spa offers massages, Ayurvedic rituals and chocolate-focused treatments such as a chocolate facial and mocha massage.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy a wide variety of massages, Ayurvedic rituals, and treatments from around the world at Kai Belté Spa. Be sure to check out the menu of chocolate-focused options like a chocolate facial and mocha massage
